Solana Career Night Toronto
event.venue: 207 Queens Quay W, Toronto, ON M5J 1A7, Canada
event.descriptionText:
Solana Career Night Toronto – Your Gateway to a Career in Solana
Whether you're a developer, founder, marketer, BD or just crypto-curious — this is your chance to learn what it actually takes to build a career in one of the fastest-growing blockchain ecosystem.
Superteam Talent, Superteam Canada and Blueshift are teaming up for a full-day program designed to give you the skills, connections, and clarity to land your next role in the Solana ecosystem.
From hands-on technical workshops to career mapping sessions — this day is built to get you from "interested" to "ready."
No matter your background or skill level, you'll leave with a concrete understanding of where the opportunities are, what teams are looking for, and how to position yourself.
Agenda
04:00pm – Doors Open & Registration Coffee, get settled, meet the community
04:15pm – Welcome & Ecosystem Overview Hosted by all partners
A short intro to the Solana ecosystem in Toronto and beyond — what's happening, who's building and why now is the time to get involved
04:30pm – Solana Ecosystem & Career Workshop Hosted by Superteam Talent                                                                             A combined session mapping the Solana landscape and showing you exactly how to build a career in it — from the teams hiring to the steps that get you there
05:00pm – Building on Solana Hosted by Blueshift 
A hands-on introductory workshop for anyone who wants to understand how to start developing on Solana
05:45pm – Meet your Toronto Solana Community Hosted by Superteam Canada                                                                             Meet the people building Solana in Toronto — who they are, what they're working on, and how to get plugged into the local community
06:00pm – Community Mixer The best part. Grab some food and a drink, meet the people you've been sitting next to all day, connect with mentors, team leads, and fellow builders
09:00pm – End
Who is this for? Developers, designers, community builders, founders and anyone curious about working in blockchain. You don't need to be technical — there's something for every skill set.
Presented by · Superteam Talent · Superteam Canada · Blueshift
